annotations.title: Request to send a postal letter (standard or registered)

description: Request that we print and send a physical letter (standard or registered mail) in Germany/EU on behalf of an identified sender. Nothing is sent before you accept our quote. Pilot service: a human reviews the request and replies with a quote or result (poll get_request_status); nothing is done or charged before you accept. Pilot price incl. postage: EUR 4.90 standard, EUR 8.90 registered (Einwurf), EUR 11.90 with return receipt (up to 3 pages).

contact_email.description: Email for our reply (recommended; otherwise poll the status URL).

deadline.description: Optional: date by which the letter must be posted or delivered.

document_url.description: Optional: https URL of a ready-to-print PDF.

max_price_eur.description: Maximum price per unit you would pay (EUR).

monthly_volume.description: If recurring: expected units per month.

principal_type.description: operator = acting for a person/organisation; independent = no human principal.

recipient_address.description: Full postal address of the recipient.

sender_name.description: Sender name (person or organisation on whose behalf we send).
